req.title: Honour Accept: application/json
req.statement: The system shall respect an Accept: application/json request header by serialising responses as JSON.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that when a client sends Accept: application/json, the server must respond with JSON-serialised content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — standard GET /get with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON content-type; (2) positive EP — POST /post with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (3) positive EP — GET /headers with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON with headers key; (4) positive EP — GET /cookies with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON with cookies key; (5) positive EP — GET /basic-auth with correct credentials and Accept: application/json yields 200 with authenticated=true; (6) negative NEG — GET /basic-auth with wrong credentials and Accept: application/json yields 401; (7) boundary BVA — Accept header with application/json alongside wildcard */* still yields JSON; (8) DT — PUT /put with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (9) DT — DELETE /delete with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (10) BVA — PATCH /patch with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact Content-Type values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /get with Accept: application/json header
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

GET /headers endpoint is available
expected: Response JSON body contains key 'headers' whose value is a dict
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_headers_accept_json_returns_headers_key_in_body():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    # The Accept header we sent must be reflected back
    accept_val = body['headers'].get('Accept') or body['headers'].get('accept')
    assert accept_val == 'application/json'

test_headers_accept_json_returns_headers_key_in_body()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_success_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with correct Basic auth credentials and Accept: application/json
expected: Response JSON body has authenticated=true and user='user'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
import base64

def test_basic_auth_success_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['authenticated'] == True
    assert body['user'] == 'user'

test_basic_auth_success_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_failure_accept_json_returns_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with WRONG credentials and Accept: application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import base64

def test_basic_auth_failure_accept_json_returns_401():
    client = app.test_client()
    bad_creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:wrongpassword').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': 'Basic ' + bad_creds
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 403
    assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in r.headers

test_basic_auth_failure_accept_json_returns_401()

tests.name: test_patch_accept_json_returns_200_and_json
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PATCH /patch endpoint is available
actions: Send PATCH /patch with Accept: application/json header and JSON body
expected: Response JSON body 'json' key reflects the sent JSON payload exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_patch_accept_json_returns_200_and_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    payload = json.dumps({'test_key': 'test_value'})
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=payload,
        content_type='application/json',
        headers={'Accept': 'application/json'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['json'] == {'test_key': 'test_value'}
    assert body['json']['test_key'] == 'test_value'

test_patch_accept_json_returns_200_and_json()

GET /get endpoint is available

Verify body is not empty dict and not a list

Body is NOT an empty dict {}
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_accept_json_response_body_is_parseable_and_not_empty():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert body != {}
    assert not isinstance(body, list)
    # Exact key count: url, args, headers, origin = 4 keys
    assert len(body) == 4
